scenes.synopsis: Mara sits inside an idling cargo van in a dark lot, nervously waiting and trying to use a walkie-talkie.
scenes.notes: Night exterior shoot. Vehicles active on set.

scenes.synopsis: Mara nervously plays with her flashlight in the cluttered van until Desh crackles through the walkie-talkie to signal him being close.
Desh sneaks past a security guard's flashlight sweep while carrying a second duffel bag.
The cargo van speeds down a dark, empty two-lane highway as rain begins to fall.
scenes.notes: Night exterior. Moving vehicle, wet down / rain machine SFX.

scenes.synopsis: Desh climbs into the back of the moving van, bringing the second duffel bag inside, and tells Mara they are clean.
Lou unzips a duffel bag to check the contents, then slides a briefcase full of cash to Mara and Desh.

schedule.title: THE HANDOFF
schedule.solver_notes: Greedy location/continuity packer, 5.882352941176471 pages/day target. Phase 3 grounds this target in the studio's own past-schedule data via MCP instead of a fixed constant. Attempt 1: 4 consecutive night days found; growing the per-day cap to 5.88 pages so same-location night scenes can consolidate. | Re-plan requested again, but the schedule was unchanged from the previous attempt (fixed point) -- stopping rather than repeating a no-op.

risk_report.title: THE HANDOFF

flags.description: The current schedule schedules Days 1, 2, 3, and 4 as four consecutive night shoots, which exceeds the safe threshold of three consecutive night shoots and creates crew fatigue.
flags.recommendation: Consolidate the short scenes to eliminate consecutive night shifts. Since the entire script is only 1.625 pages, we can combine several night locations onto single shoot days.

flags.description: Scene 4 on Day 4 is an exterior night highway shoot with moving vehicles and rain VFX/wet-down effects.
flags.recommendation: Secure rain effects equipment, hire wet-down crew, coordinate wet pavement driving safety briefings, and establish a weather backup/contingency plan.

flags.description: The line item 'Vendor: Picture Vehicle (Stripped-Down Sedan)' has grounded=false with an estimate of $0.0 due to missing vendor rate data.
flags.recommendation: Get a manual quote from picture vehicle vendors for the stripped-down sedan to ground the budget item.

flags.description: The cargo van is used on Days 1, 2, and 4, and the duffel bags are used on Days 2, 3, 4, and 5.
flags.recommendation: Assign script supervisor and art department to strictly track state/placement of the duffel bag props and the physical status/debris inside the cargo van.

risk_report.replan_reason: Four consecutive night shoot days create high fatigue. Because the total script length is under 2 pages, the scheduler can pack these short scenes into fewer days to avoid a long string of consecutive nights.
